en.headline: Fire Services seize 921 litres of petrol from illegal station in Tsz Lok Estate car park
en.dek: A 34-year-old two-way permit holder was intercepted after officers found a seven-seater van leaking fuel and fitted with a tank and refuelling tools; enough petrol for about 20 private cars was recovered.
body: The Fire Services Department has dismantled an illegal petrol station operating inside the car park of Tsz Lok Estate Phase 2 in Wong Tai Sin, seizing 921 litres of petrol and intercepting a 34-year-old man holding a two-way permit.

Officers responded to a public report on Monday evening of a vehicle leaking fuel and a strong petrol smell in the car park. They found a seven-seater van with petrol leaking from it, covered the spill with sawdust and secured the scene. Inside the van they discovered a fuel tank together with a set of refuelling tools.

The recovered petrol was enough to fill roughly 20 private cars. All fuel and equipment were taken away. The man is alleged to have breached the Dangerous Goods Ordinance for excessive storage of dangerous goods, packaging and labelling requirements, and the Fire Services Ordinance for illegal possession of controlled substances.

The department noted that Tsz Lok Estate is a large residential complex with heavy pedestrian and vehicle traffic. Petrol vapour is heavier than air and can accumulate, creating a serious explosion risk in a car park that lacks the specialised fire-safety equipment of a licensed filling station. Fire officers later held an urgent meeting with the District Office, the Wong Tai Sin District Fire Safety Committee and the estate management company to strengthen vigilance against illegal fuel activities.

zh.headline: 消防搗破慈樂邨停車場非法加油站 檢921公升汽油截查雙程證男
zh.dek: 一輛七人車漏油，車內發現油缸及入油工具，檢獲足以注滿約20輛私家車的汽油；34歲持雙程證男子涉嫌多項危險品及消防條例罪行。
body: 消防處搗破黃大仙慈樂邨第二期停車場內的非法加油站，檢獲921公升汽油，並截查一名34歲持雙程證男子。
昨晚接獲市民舉報指停車場有汽車漏油及傳出燃油氣味。消防員到場發現一輛七人車正在洩漏燃油，隨即以木糠覆蓋漏油位置並戒備。其後在車內發現油缸及一批入油工具。
檢獲的汽油容量足以注滿約20輛私家車，全部燃油及工具已檢走。該名男子涉嫌違反《危險品條例》下過量貯存危險品、包裝標記及標籤要求，以及《消防條例》非法管有受管制物質等罪行。
消防處指出，慈樂邨屬大型住宅屋邨，停車場人流車流極高。汽油屬高度易燃液體，揮發蒸氣比空氣重，極易積聚並引致爆炸。不法分子在沒有加油站專用消防裝置的停車場內違法貯存及轉注汽油，一旦發生火警甚至爆炸，將嚴重威脅居民及使用者安全。處方今日已與當區民政事務處、黃大仙區防火委員會及物管公司舉行緊急會議，加強對非法燃油活動的警覺。
